youtube.title: Inter's best signing ever: Lautaro or Zanetti? #Shorts
youtube.description:
Inter's best signing ever? Our pick: Lautaro Martínez (2018, from Racing).
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?v=debate5 — the Italian Inter press in English every morning, free

THE DEBATE — a weekly fan-made argument, not the news.

Javier Zanetti (1995, Banfield): 858 games and 16 trophies, both club records; 5 Scudetti, 4 Coppa Italia, 4 Supercoppa, UEFA Cup 1998, Champions League 2010, Club World Cup 2010; captain of the 2010 treble.
Ronaldo (1997, Barcelona, a world-record fee): 99 games, 59 goals, UEFA Cup 1998 (scored in the final), Ballon d'Or 1997.
Wesley Sneijder (2009, Real Madrid, a reported €15M): 116 games, 22 goals, the 2009–10 treble, 4th in the 2010 Ballon d'Or.
Diego Milito (2009, Genoa, a reported €28M): 171 games, 75 goals; 30 in 2009–10, both goals in the 2010 Champions League final.
Lautaro Martínez (2018, Racing, a reported €22.7M): 181 goals, third all-time at Inter; Scudetti 2021, 2024, 2026; Coppa Italia 2022, 2023, 2026; Supercoppa 2021, 2022, 2023; Serie A top scorer 2023–24 and 2025–26; captain.
Marcus Thuram (2023, free): 54 goals in 147 games; Scudetti 2024 and 2026; Coppa Italia 2026.

Sources: inter.it (all-time scorers, honours, news archive), uefa.com, Wikipedia (English and Italian), football-italia.net.
Fan-made — not affiliated with FC Internazionale Milano.

#Inter #ForzaInter #Lautaro #Zanetti #SerieA #Shorts

sources.claim: Lautaro Martínez: 181 goals in official competitions, third on Inter's all-time list behind Meazza (284) and Altobelli (209); table updated Oct 13, 2026
Lautaro: Serie A top scorer 2025–26 (17 goals in 30 games), his second title after 2023–24; only he and Meazza won it twice in Scudetto seasons
Inter champions of Italy 2025–26, Scudetto No. 21 (May 4, 2026); Lautaro the captain
Coppa Italia final May 13, 2026: Lazio 0–2 Inter, Lautaro 35'; Inter's 10th Coppa Italia and the domestic double

Lautaro joined Inter July 4, 2018 for a reported €22.7M; honours Serie A 2020–21, 2023–24, 2025–26; Coppa Italia 2021–22, 2022–23, 2025–26; Supercoppa 2021, 2022, 2023 (9); Serie A MVP 2023–24; captain after Handanovič
Racing president Blanco (Mar 2018): '27 million plus 10% of a future sale … 30 million dollars' — fee figures disagree, so no fee is on a frame
Zanetti: 858 Inter appearances and 16 trophies (5 Serie A, 4 Coppa Italia, 4 Supercoppa, 1 UEFA Cup, 1 Champions League, 1 Club World Cup); debut Aug 27, 1995 v Vicenza; arrived with Rambert
Zanetti: 858 apps / 21 goals all competitions (1995–2014), club records for appearances and trophies; first to captain an Italian club to the treble
Zanetti fee: 10 billion lire in July 1995 covered Zanetti AND Rambert together (no separate figure) — not on screen
Ronaldo at Inter: 99 appearances, 59 goals, one UEFA Cup, two Ballon d'Ors; arrived July 25, 1997; lifted the Ballon d'Or at San Siro Jan 4, 1998
1998 UEFA Cup final, Paris, May 6, 1998: Lazio 0–3 Inter — Zamorano 4', Zanetti 60', Ronaldo 70'
Ronaldo 1997 fee £19.5M, a world transfer record (press; Sky Sport Italia says 55 billion lire — figures differ, 'world-record fee' only in the caption)
Sneijder bought Aug 27, 2009 for a reported €15M; 116 apps, 22 goals; 2009–10 treble; 4th in the 2010 Ballon d'Or

Milito: fee €28M per Gazzetta (May 20, 2009, with Thiago Motta); 171 apps, 75 goals; 30 goals in 2009–10; both goals in the 2–0 Champions League final v Bayern May 22, 2010; UEFA Club Footballer of the Year 2010
Milito signed from Genoa June 29, 2009, Acquafresca the other way, four-year deal
Thuram signed July 1, 2023 as a free agent; 147 apps, 54 goals (as of Oct 13, 2026); Serie A 2023–24 and 2025–26; Coppa Italia 2025–26; Supercoppa 2023

verification.fees: all transfer fees are reported press figures that disagree between sources; none is on a frame (only Thuram's 'free'); captions say 'reported'
verification.lautaro_goals: inter.it table (Oct 13, 2026) says 181; an older paragraph on the same page says 177 — table used
verification.fix_dict: no addition needed (Lautaro, Lautaro Martínez, Sneijder, Thuram, Javier Zanetti, Milito already in FIX; Zanetti and Ronaldo via Italian G2P)
